text:
maya: Kicking off a controlled traffic shift for inference-service -> model v2.3. Change window ok (Q1 deploy slot). Starting 10% -> target 50% over 25m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-11-v2.3 :rocket:
deploy-bot: [automated] traffic-shift started | canary_id=can-20260311-77 | from=10% to=50% | step=5% every 2m
jon: copying notes here — monitoring: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost. I'll watch APM and logs.
anita: added the eval set to the rollout dashboard (prompt-suite v2.3). Will flag quality regressions.
leo: quick check — pinned routing table to prefer region-us-central for canary to limit blast radius.
sam: heads-up: I see a small p95 blip +0.12s at 10% on the realtime bucket, but error rate stable.
ops-bot: [alert] Realtime latency p95 > baseline by 10% for service=inference-service region=us-central (detected at 1770001142) :warning:
maya: seen. holding next step until we confirm it's not a transient microburst. Can we get traces for a few requests?
jon: grabbing traces now. stack traces show KV cache misses for ~30% of requests to v2.3. Looks like the warmup didn't populate prefixes as expected.
anita: that matches eval results — some early prefix patterns cause cache churn. We can mitigate by increasing prefix prewarm to 3 tokens and rerun canary step.
leo: do we want to roll forward with adjusted warmup or rollback to v2.2 for affected buckets?
sam: proposal: partial rollback for realtime route only (keep batch and async on v2.3). That reduces exposure and buys time to fix warmup.
maya: agreed with partial rollback plan. sam, can you execute rollback for route=real-time? Include a pin so we don't auto-shift back.
sam: running rollback command now:
```bash
redwood deploy traffic --service inference-service --route real-time --to-version v2.2 --pin yes --reason "partial rollback due to KV cache churn"
```
sam: rollback initiated, route real-time -> v2.2. Deploy bot should confirm.
deploy-bot: [automated] traffic-shift executed | canary_id=can-20260311-77 | route=real-time | from=10% on v2.3 -> 10% on v2.2 | pin=true | status=ok
ops-bot: [info] No new 5xx spikes observed since route rollback. Monitoring continuing.
maya: thanks. I'm pausing the overall rollout until we validate prewarm fix. Changed target to HOLD at 25%. Update release notes and incident log.
anita: will add a short regression test for KV prewarm and re-run in the staging cluster. ETA ~45m.
jon: I'll keep an eye on latency and error dashboards. If stable for 30m, we can re-evaluate for an incremental resume.
leo: added a note to the console: canary pinned on real-time route, percent-shift paused.
maya: thumbs-up. tagging @eng-oncall in case anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
